headlines.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Jon Moxley vs. Chris Jericho went to battle over the AEW Interim World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.43 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Moxley made Jericho tap to a Rear Naked Choke in a bloody main event, and the show closed with a returning CM Punk facing him down for the first time as interim champion.
On this day in 2024, The Varsity Athletes left that name behind for good, stepping out as The Premier Athletes after 2 matches under the old identity, on Collision.
On this day in 2024, Gunns & Robinson vs. House of Black met in a Number One Contender, in the show-closing main event slot on Collision, rated 6.61.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2022, Andrade & Rush stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.32 ? a solid showing.
Rewind to 2024, when Thunder Rosa vs. Deonna Purrazzo settled things in a Texas Bullrope match on Collision, rated 7.04 ? a match that delivered in a big night for the women's side of the roster.

2022 brought us this moment: Darby Allin vs. Brody King fought it out in a Coffin Match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.56 ? a match that delivered, part of the special Quake by the Lake '22 card.
